adventure.title: Spell Arena
adventure.introduction: A proving ground for spellcasting mechanics. You are a novice wizard in a dusty sand-floored arena. Two enemies block the northern corridor: a goblin grunt and a hulking hobgoblin. Fight your way through.

arena.name: The Arena
arena.description: A circular sand-floored arena ringed by cracked stone walls. A narrow corridor leads north, but two enemies stand between you and the exit: a scrawny goblin grunt with a rusty shortsword and a hulking hobgoblin hefting a morningstar.

corridor.name: Exit Corridor
corridor.description: A narrow stone corridor leading out of the arena. The sounds of combat fade behind you.

goblin_grunt.name: Goblin Grunt
goblin_grunt.description: A scrawny goblin wielding a rusty shortsword. Frail — one good spell should drop it.

hobgoblin.name: Hobgoblin
hobgoblin.description: A hulking hobgoblin in lacquered plate, hefting a morningstar. Disciplined and hard to put down.
